perspective_summary: Engineering decision: retain the frozen simple-first P2T canonical and make state dependence testable through one hash-bound data contract and one matched full-versus-no_M0 arm contract. H_state is that the case-matched patient-excluded M0 state contributes conditional information for legal-joint, target, and scope prediction beyond the identical signed cue, geometry, and non-M0 context; the strongest alternative H_cue is that cue polarity, geometry, and construction regularities are sufficient, so the matched arms are equivalent at patient level. The proposed native interfaces use an explicit 17-channel episode tensor, separate state/cue supports and geometry, exactly six legal joint logits plus operation/target/scope heads, a complete M0-derived-path manifest, patient-only analysis, contract tests, and a cryptographically linked receipt chain. Every named module is PLANNED_ADAPTER or UNVERIFIED, not IMPLEMENTED. The current operational state is PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED: exact downstream bundle/F0 closure is unresolved and both server candidates remain UNKNOWN until authorized live evidence is recorded. No GPU execution, task state, metric, result, token use, or cost is asserted.

observations.statement: H_state: for otherwise identical episodes, access to the case-matched patient-excluded M0 changes the patient-level legal-joint risk, with the distinguishing signal expected in joint, target, and/or scope rather than operation alone. Strongest alternative H_cue: signed polarity, geometry, non-M0 context, and generator regularities already contain all predictive information, so full and no_M0 have equal patient-level risk apart from sampling variation. Both are untested design hypotheses.

The model contract must expose exactly six joint classes: ADD_SAME_LOCAL, REMOVE_SAME_LOCAL, ADD_SAME_COMPLETE, REMOVE_SAME_COMPLETE, ADD_NEW_COMPLETE, and REMOVE_NEW_COMPLETE, plus two-way operation, target, and scope heads. ADD_NEW_LOCAL and REMOVE_NEW_LOCAL are rejected at ingestion and can never be emitted as legal joint probabilities. Scribble polarity remains distinct from the intent label: FN produces positive ADD cues and FP produces negative REMOVE cues.

Proposed EpisodeRecord v1 is a PLANNED_ADAPTER, not an observed implementation. It contains episode_tensor float32[17,D,H,W] with finite values; state_support bool[1,D,H,W]; cue_support bool[1,D,H,W]; geometry float32[G] with finite G fixed by a hashed geometry schema; scribble_polarity int8 in {-1,+1}; geometry_family in {centerline,random,boundary}; joint_label in the six-name legal set; operation, target, and scope labels; episode_kind in {controlled,natural}; split in {train,validation,test}; and lineage-only episode_id, case_id, patient_id, m0_artifact_sha256, source_grid_digest, transform_chain_digest, and episode_builder_digest. Identifiers and digests are available only to loaders/auditors/aggregators and are prohibited model features. The ordered 17-channel map, G, dtype/range normalization, spacing/orientation policy, and every M0-derived channel/support/cache must be supplied and SHA-256 frozen during bundle/F0 closure; they are UNKNOWN here and may not be guessed or silently reordered.

Primary ArmContract v1 has only full and no_M0. Both consume the same episode-manifest digest, patient split, scribble voxels, polarity, geometry, non-M0 channels, labels, backbone, pooling, geometry MLP, heads, initialization/seed policy, minibatch order, optimizer, schedule, stopping rule, checkpoint rule, and total budget. A hash-bound m0_path_manifest must enumerate every direct or derived M0 path: tensor channel indices, state-support masks, normalization statistics, cached features, sampler strata, episode metadata, filenames, and transforms. no_M0 applies one precommitted neutralization value or removal rule per enumerated path while preserving the declared tensor/interface shape; an arm-parity receipt must prove that no other field differs. The exact neutralization rules are UNKNOWN until F0 closure and cannot be selected after outcomes.

Minimum logical surfaces are all PLANNED_ADAPTER/UNVERIFIED: EpisodeContract.validate(record)->ContractReport; OOFBindingAudit.audit(oof_manifest,episode_manifest,split_manifest)->LineageReceipt; M0Ablation.apply(record,arm,m0_path_manifest)->record; SimpleP2T.forward(episode_tensor,state_support,cue_support,geometry)->{joint_logits[B,6],operation_logits[B,2],target_logits[B,2],scope_logits[B,2]}; TrainEntrypoint.fit(run_spec,arm)->CheckpointManifest; PredictEntrypoint.predict(checkpoint,episode_manifest)->PredictionManifest; PatientAnalyzer.compare(full_predictions,no_M0_predictions,analysis_spec)->AnalysisArtifact; TwoServerSelector.select(resource_requirements,two_candidates,live_probe_receipts)->ResourceSelectionReceipt; and ReceiptEmitter.link(parent_receipts,artifact_manifest)->Receipt. No native file, symbol, repository, dependency, checkpoint, or script has been inspected, so no IMPLEMENTED or SCRIPT_PRESENT claim is admissible from this contribution.

Use four non-interchangeable execution states. SCRIPT_PRESENT means a script/config manifest exists, every entry has a content digest, and static import/schema tests passed; it does not imply deployability or execution. PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED means at least one bundle/F0, data, leakage, coverage, coordinate, arm-parity, resource, or receipt prerequisite is absent or failed, and job submission is forbidden. READY means SCRIPT_PRESENT plus all preflight gates passed, both live candidate probes are receipt-bound, exactly one eligible server was selected by the frozen policy, and the exact launch manifest is frozen; READY still means not run. EXECUTED requires a non-LLM executor receipt binding the launch digest, selected server reference, external job identifier, start/end times, exit code, logs, and raw-output manifest; it does not by itself create a scientific result. This design is currently PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED by unresolved exact bundle/F0 closure and UNKNOWN live resources; SCRIPT_PRESENT and EXECUTED are not asserted.

ReceiptChain v1 is PLANNED_ADAPTER and requires: design_input_receipt binding work-order id, nonce, frozen-brief digest, and the three dependency digests; bundle_f0_receipt binding source snapshot, dependency lock, runtime/container, configuration, channel map, and F0 digests; data_lineage_receipt binding immutable OOF manifest, expected 597 cases/378 patients, one patient-excluded M0 per eligible case, patient split, episode manifest, atlas/coverage gate, and coordinate audit; arm_parity_receipt binding full/no_M0 manifests and the M0-path diff; resource_selection_receipt binding both same-window live probes and the chosen opaque resource ref; preflight_receipt binding named test results and launch digest; executor_receipt binding the actual external run and raw outputs; and analysis_receipt binding predictions, patient aggregation, statistic configuration, and report. Each receipt carries schema_version, created_at, artifact_sha256 values, parent_receipt_sha256 values, issuer type, and signature/verification status. Missing, unverifiable, or broken links block promotion to the next state. No receipt in this list is claimed to exist yet.

RunSpec.resource_selection must contain exactly two candidate reference fields, primary_server_ref and secondary_server_ref, plus selected_server_ref, selection_policy_version, required_accelerator_count, required_accelerator_class, min_free_vram_bytes, max_walltime_seconds, primary_live_probe_receipt_sha256, secondary_live_probe_receipt_sha256, selected_reason, and evidence_observed_at. Server references are opaque resource-registry identifiers, never credentials. required_* values must be frozen from the workload before probing. Both candidates currently have evidence_status=UNKNOWN and selected_server_ref=null: no health, idleness, queue, running-task, GPU, VRAM, mount, scheduler, or bundle fact is available in the local packet. Only authorized read-only, same-window live probes may change UNKNOWN to ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE; a valid probe must bind bundle/F0 digest match, data-mount readability, scheduler/submission capability, accelerator facts, capacity, queue evidence, and timestamp. If neither is eligible, remain PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED; if both are eligible, the frozen deterministic policy selects one without inventing availability.

Required preflight tests are named and fail closed: T01 episode schema/dtype/shape/finite-value validation; T02 ordered 17-channel-map digest and no silent transpose; T03 exactly-six-joint mapping with NEW_LOCAL rejection; T04 FN-positive-ADD and FP-negative-REMOVE polarity invariants; T05 one case-to-one frozen OOF M0 binding and expected 597-case/378-patient manifest counts; T06 zero patient/duplicate-exam overlap across splits; T07 all episodes from one patient share a split; T08 PET/CT/reference/M0/residual/scribble grid, orientation, spacing, and transform-chain compatibility; T09 identical episode and non-M0 payload hashes across full/no_M0; T10 exhaustive M0 path neutralization with no M0-derived cache/statistic/metadata left in no_M0; T11 no identifiers, residuals, ground-truth masks, labels, filenames, or arm token enter inference features; T12 forward-output shapes [B,6]/[B,2]/[B,2]/[B,2] and finite loss/gradient on a synthetic contract fixture; T13 deterministic replay under the frozen seed policy; T14 patient-level aggregation/resampling on a fixture where episode-level and patient-level answers differ; T15 receipt parent-hash tamper detection; T16 four-state transition rejection; and T17 two-server selection refusal on UNKNOWN, stale, or digest-mismatched probes. These tests are specified, not reported as run or passing.

The first operational action is exact downstream bundle/F0 closure. The committed 597-case, 378-patient OOF M0 is an immutable upstream input: engineering may hash, bind, validate, and consume it, but must not regenerate, refit, select, or rerun it to repair the stale downstream bundle. Closure proceeds downstream only: bundle/F0, then M0 evaluation, FN/FP atlas, signed episodes, P2T/editor/comparators, and patient-level statistics.

No v2 training, inference, metric, effect, comparator outcome, GPU run, task status, token usage, or cost is established by the supplied packet. Execution fields remain absent or UNKNOWN until an external receipt supplies them. Token/cost fields may be populated only from provider/runtime billing evidence linked to a run receipt; they must never be estimated from script size, wall time, checkpoint presence, or model configuration. SCRIPT_PRESENT, READY, and EXECUTED are operational facts, not scientific conclusions; a claim requires a separate verified analysis receipt and the preregistered patient-level interpretation gates.

Cross-attention, FiLM, gated fusion, and PET-to-CT modality fusion are excluded from the current module registry and launch matrix. Cross-attention may appear only as a separately authorized future ablation after the simple-first full-versus-no_M0 primary is complete; it cannot replace the canonical model, be launched as a rescue, or consume the current primary budget.

proposed_mechanisms.description: Implementable contract for the frozen simple-first state-conditioned P2T mechanism. It preserves the canonical 17-channel state/cue representation, separate state/cue-support pooling, geometry MLP, and joint/operation/target/scope heads. The full/no_M0 contrast tests incremental access to M0; it does not introduce a new fusion architecture.
inputs: EpisodeRecord v1: episode_tensor float32[B,17,D,H,W], state_support bool[B,1,D,H,W], cue_support bool[B,1,D,H,W], geometry float32[B,G], and separate lineage metadata
Case-matched frozen patient-excluded M0 artifact plus m0_artifact_sha256 and immutable OOF binding; never an OOF rerun
Signed scribble with polarity in {-1,+1}, geometry_family in {centerline,random,boundary}, and identical cue voxels/geometry across primary arms
Six-legal-joint labels plus operation, target, and scope labels; labels and construction residuals excluded from inference features
ArmContract v1 with an exhaustive hash-bound m0_path_manifest and frozen neutralization rule for no_M0
RunSpec v1 binding channel map, geometry schema, patient split, episode manifest, optimizer/schedule/budget, seeds, checkpoint rule, metric/analysis spec, and receipt parents
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: Validate and batch EpisodeRecord values without exposing identifiers. The unchanged backbone maps the proposed [B,17,D,H,W] tensor to spatial features H. Apply the canonical state-support pool and cue-support pool to H, map geometry through the canonical geometry MLP, concatenate only through the simple-first fusion interface, and emit joint_logits[B,6], operation_logits[B,2], target_logits[B,2], and scope_logits[B,2]. The joint head uses only the six frozen legal labels; component heads are diagnostics and cannot synthesize NEW_LOCAL into the legal joint space. Train with one precommitted multi-head loss configuration whose weights are identical across arms and frozen before outcomes. For full, all declared M0 paths are active. For no_M0, M0Ablation applies exactly the frozen path-wise neutralizations while leaving record identities, non-M0 payloads, code, parameter-budget policy, data order, optimizer, stopping, and budget unchanged. Channel identities, loss weights, and neutral values remain UNKNOWN until F0 and must be recorded rather than inferred.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: The preregistered observable is a paired held-out patient-level full-minus-no_M0 difference for the primary six-joint loss/metric, with target and scope contrasts as mechanistic diagnostics. H_state predicts a positive difference in joint and target/scope conditional on identical cues; operation-only separation is not distinguishing because polarity already exposes ADD/REMOVE. H_cue predicts equivalence within a margin frozen before prediction access. No direction, size, feasibility, or result is claimed here.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: The mechanism is uninterpretable if the channel map or M0 path inventory is incomplete; if no_M0 retains any state-derived feature or differs on non-state data/code/budget; if patient/case/M0 binding, physical coordinates, polarity, six-joint coverage, or split isolation fails; if administrative fields leak; if the patient rather than episode is not the analysis unit; or if exact bundle/F0 and receipt chains do not close. Any such failure returns PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED and cannot be repaired by rerunning OOF M0 or substituting cross-attention.

proposed_mechanisms.description: A fail-closed engineering envelope that turns a design into an auditable launch without confusing scripts or executor activity with scientific evidence. It binds inputs, arm parity, two candidate resources, tests, launch, raw outputs, and patient-level analysis through content-addressed receipts.
inputs: Verified design_input_receipt for WO-ENGINEERING nonce SM001_research_engineering_planner_nonce_0001 and the frozen brief/dependency digests
bundle_f0_receipt, data_lineage_receipt, arm_parity_receipt, atlas/coverage decision, coordinate audit, and named test manifest
Exactly two opaque resource references: primary_server_ref and secondary_server_ref; current values and all live facts are UNKNOWN in this contribution
Resource requirements frozen before live probes, two same-window authorized live probe receipts, deterministic selection policy, and selected_server_ref
Hash-bound launch manifest, non-LLM executor receipt, raw-output manifest, prediction manifest, and patient-analysis receipt
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: ReceiptEmitter verifies parent hashes and signatures before every state transition. A content-hashed script/config manifest may establish SCRIPT_PRESENT only. Any failed or missing F0, lineage, coverage, coordinate, parity, test, resource, or receipt field yields PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED and prohibits submission. READY is emitted only when all tests pass and TwoServerSelector has two fresh probe receipts and selects exactly one eligible candidate using the frozen requirements/policy. An external executor may then emit EXECUTED only by binding the selected resource, launch digest, job identity, timestamps, exit code, logs, and raw outputs. PatientAnalyzer consumes only receipt-bound paired prediction manifests and groups/resamples by patient. Usage/cost remain UNKNOWN unless independent billing/runtime evidence is linked; EXECUTED alone is not a metric or conclusion.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: A valid engineering run produces a continuous verifiable chain from frozen inputs to raw outputs and a patient-level analysis artifact, with every state transition reproducible and every full/no_M0 difference attributable only to the M0 contract. This is an operational validity signal, not evidence that state-relative intent is effective or novel.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: Reject READY or EXECUTED when a receipt is missing, stale, unsigned/unverified, parent-hash inconsistent, or does not match the launch/artifact digests; when server facts are assumed from local text; when selected_server_ref is absent or outside the two frozen candidates; when a job is submitted while UNKNOWN/PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED; when raw outputs cannot be traced to the launch; or when tokens, costs, metrics, or results are inferred rather than evidenced.

experiments.comparison: Compare the intended downstream source/runtime/configuration/channel/data contract against the exact deployed bundle/F0 receipt, then evaluate exactly two opaque server candidates using authorized same-window live probes and the frozen resource policy. This is a preflight comparison only; it does not run M0, P2T, or an experiment.
held_constant: the committed 597-case/378-patient patient-excluded OOF M0 manifest, without regeneration or substitution
the frozen scientific brief, six-joint ontology, simple-first architecture, and full-versus-no_M0 primary
resource requirements and deterministic selection policy frozen before either live probe
probe schema, freshness window, bundle/F0 digest requirements, mount/scheduler checks, and receipt verifier applied identically to both candidate references
no credentials in manifests, receipts, outputs, or this contribution
experiments.observable: Produce bundle_f0_receipt and two live probe receipts that report evidence rather than assumptions, then resource_selection_receipt with selected_server_ref or an explicit no-eligible-resource decision. Validate source/runtime/config/channel-map/F0 digest equality; data mount readability; scheduler submission capability without launching; declared accelerator/count/VRAM facts; queue evidence; probe time/freshness; and receipt signatures. The current observable is only PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED with both live candidates UNKNOWN; no server health, idle state, job state, GPU, token, cost, or performance value is supplied.
experiments.falsifier: Remain PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED and submit no job if the exact bundle/F0 cannot be reproduced, either probe is missing/stale/unverified, required fields are UNKNOWN, neither candidate satisfies the frozen requirements, the two-candidate set changes after probing, or the selected resource cannot be justified by the frozen policy. Do not rerun OOF M0 as remediation.

experiments.comparison: On synthetic contract fixtures and a frozen metadata-only manifest audit, compare full and no_M0 records before any GPU submission. Assert that the same EpisodeRecord IDs and all non-M0 bytes are identical and that only paths listed in m0_path_manifest change under no_M0. This validates wiring, not scientific feasibility or performance.
held_constant: ordered 17-channel map, geometry schema, tensor shapes/dtypes, legal-label mapping, and physical-grid contract
episode, case, patient, split, scribble, geometry, label, non-M0 channel, and data-order manifests
SimpleP2T forward/loss interface, weights/initialization policy, optimizer configuration, checkpoint rule, and total budget
receipt verifier and all T01-T17 pass/fail criteria
no access to test outcomes and no external execution
experiments.observable: Emit machine-readable ContractReport, LineageReceipt, ArmParityReceipt, and named T01-T17 test records. Required properties are correct [B,6]/[B,2]/[B,2]/[B,2] outputs; zero illegal joint admissions; finite fixture loss/gradients; correct polarity invariants; exactly one frozen M0 binding per eligible case; patient-exclusive splits; coordinate compatibility; identical episode/non-M0 hashes; exhaustive removal of M0-derived paths from no_M0; identifier/ground-truth/residual exclusion; deterministic fixture replay; correct patient aggregation; broken-receipt rejection; illegal state-transition rejection; and UNKNOWN/stale two-server probe rejection. No test is claimed run or passing in this design contribution.
experiments.falsifier: Any failed or unevidenced test keeps the run PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED. In particular stop if any legal joint is absent below the precommitted patient-support gate, NEW_LOCAL appears, a patient crosses splits, M0/case binding is not unique, coordinates differ, non-M0 bytes differ between arms, an M0-derived path survives no_M0, or a model feature carries an identifier, residual, ground truth, label, filename, or arm token.

experiments.comparison: After exact bundle/F0 closure, atlas/coverage and leakage gates, SCRIPT_PRESENT evidence, complete preflight, and READY resource selection, run only the frozen simple-first full versus no_M0 primary on the exact same controlled/natural episode manifest. Polarity-blind and geometry-only remain frozen diagnostics; cross-attention is absent and reserved for future ablation.
held_constant: patient-disjoint split, immutable OOF M0 files, same case/episode IDs, signed scribbles, polarity, geometry, labels, and controlled/natural mix
all non-M0 tensor paths, preprocessing, normalization, sampler, minibatch order, and cache inputs
simple 17-channel backbone, state/cue-support pooling, geometry MLP, joint/operation/target/scope heads, and parameter-budget policy
seed set, initialization policy, optimizer, schedule, regularization, epoch/step budget, stopping and checkpoint-selection rules
primary patient-level endpoint, paired analysis, uncertainty method, missingness rule, legal-class handling, equivalence/smallest-relevant-effect rule, and receipt chain frozen before outcome access
one READY-selected resource reference and exact launch digest per paired arm according to the precommitted execution policy
experiments.observable: Bind both arm prediction manifests to executor receipts, reduce episode/case values to patient contributions, and compute the preregistered paired patient-level full-minus-no_M0 primary joint contrast and uncertainty. Report target and scope as mechanistic diagnostics, operation as a polarity-shortcut check, six-joint patient support/confusion, calibration if precommitted, and controlled/natural slices without changing the primary. Treat an operation-only gain as non-distinguishing. Metrics, effects, runtime, tokens, and costs remain UNKNOWN until their own verified receipts exist.
experiments.falsifier: After all validity gates pass, falsify H_state for this interface when the predeclared patient-level rule from the frozen analysis spec is met, including a nonpositive upper confidence bound or accepted equivalence if that is the frozen criterion; otherwise report inconclusive as specified. Stop without interpretation for receipt breakage, arm drift, patient leakage, M0 mismatch, insufficient six-joint patient support, generator shortcut, coordinate failure, or outcome-informed configuration. An unfavorable result cannot authorize cross-attention rescue or OOF rerun.

blockers: FIRST OPERATIONAL BLOCKER: close and verify the exact downstream bundle/F0 after the stale deployed-bundle failure. Until bundle_f0_receipt exists and verifies, current state is PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED; do not start M0 evaluation, training, or server submission, and do not rerun the committed OOF M0 set.

IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE BLOCKER: exact native code surfaces, ordered 17-channel map, geometry dimension/schema, normalization, M0-derived-path inventory, no_M0 neutralization values, loss weights, scripts, dependencies, and tests were not among authorized inputs. They remain PLANNED_ADAPTER/UNVERIFIED; no IMPLEMENTED or SCRIPT_PRESENT assertion is allowed until hash-bound evidence is supplied.

SCIENTIFIC COVERAGE BLOCKER: the FN/FP atlas must precommit and pass patient-level support thresholds for all six legal joints, confirm correct polarity and zero NEW_LOCAL data, and expose generator shortcuts before v2 P2T training. Failure stops; it does not justify class invention, post hoc resampling, or OOF regeneration.

LINEAGE/LEAKAGE BLOCKER: patient/exam identity, duplicate/longitudinal handling, one-case/one-M0 binding, patient-exclusive splits, physical-coordinate alignment, label provenance, missingness, full/no_M0 byte parity, and exhaustive M0 removal from no_M0 must verify before READY.

TWO-SERVER LIVE-EVIDENCE BLOCKER: primary_server_ref, secondary_server_ref, their health/capacity/queue/mount/scheduler/bundle facts, and selected_server_ref are UNKNOWN from the packet. Only authorized receipt-bound live probes may resolve them. Never infer idle/healthy/running status; submit no job if no candidate is evidenced eligible.

RECEIPT/TRUTH BLOCKER: SCRIPT_PRESENT, READY, EXECUTED, metrics, GPU/task state, tokens, and costs require their specific verified receipts. Never promote scripts, checkpoints, a design contribution, an executor exit, or an unverified artifact into a scientific result.

ARCHITECTURE BOUNDARY: cross-attention, FiLM, gated fusion, and PET-to-CT modality fusion are future ablations only. The first-paper canonical remains simple-first full versus no_M0 with polarity-blind and geometry-only diagnostics.
